about: Shared test vectors of the role core (docs/ROLES.md). Generated from tests/perm-vectors.src.mjs; copy byte for byte. Sections catalogue, builtins, parseStore, parseUser, effective, can, covers, coversScope, lastAdmin, validateRole, deleteCheck, legacyName run in every runtime; templates, migrate, baseKeys and newKeys are JS only. parseStore: a stored Viewer takes the built-in Viewer level for every catalogue row that is not in baseKeys and has no stored level (S14); custom roles are not filled. A role given as "unrestricted" means effective("unrestricted"). coversScope: the editor is resolveTree(editor grants, tree) with the access core, or unrestricted. lastAdmin: each user's eff = effective(roles[roleId]); change.newRoleId null = deleted; change.newRole for a role edit. validateRole: store = store1, editor = Admin unless given, editorAccess unrestricted unless given (then resolveTree(grants, tree)); errors compared exactly, missing / outside / role only when the case lists them. parseStore: ids in order, warnings exactly, roles listed are compared whole.
